bootstrap.non_equivalence_rule: failure to exclude zero is unresolved and must not be called equivalence
bootstrap.paired_comparisons: all factor swaps, factorial contrasts, and alpha-null comparisons resample the same subjects
bootstrap.unit: virtual subject; repeated relations, exposures, donor pairs, and null permutations are averaged within subject before resampling

claim_boundary: This is a read-only two-seed mechanism-discovery diagnostic on frozen pilot checkpoints. It does not train, alter checkpoints or architecture, access formal seeds, use exact posterior innovation as a trial-level target, or establish a biological identity for modeled DA.

execution_contract.device: GPU for neural replay; CPU for summaries
execution_contract.seed_subject_or_relation_filtering: forbidden except the prospectively defined stable-omission and retained-evidence masks

factor_contract.composition: C(D_a, E_b) = sum over steps 2 and 3 of [delta d_(a,k) Ebar_(b,k) + dbar_(a,k) delta E_(b,k)]
factor_contract.identity: C(D_a, E_a) exactly equals the summed matched pre-clip write difference for source a
factor_contract.interpretation: the DA factor is the pair (dbar, delta d); the eligibility factor is the pair (Ebar, delta E)
factor_contract.matched_branches: plus and zero-magnitude branches share subject, recipient P, cues, orientation, time, and recurrent steps

overall_diagnosis.pilot_stop_rule: if direction, gain, history attribution, and alpha placement are localized without implementation failure, stop mechanism discovery pilots and freeze an independent mechanism_confirmation_v1 before any access to formal seeds 2001 through 2010

working_theory.algorithm: meta-learned state-dependent iterative relaxation, not sequential exact Bayesian updating
working_theory.alpha_role: meta-learned placement of writes into recurrently high-gain directions
working_theory.history_role: P_t changes how repeated evidence is converted into eligibility, DA, or their interaction
working_theory.update_operator: s_(t+1) = s_t + Psi_theta(e_t, P_t), with only the accumulated terminal solution expected to be posterior-like
